name_reason: Current descriptor 'cinematic ... for_special_scenes' is inaccurate. Both call sites invoke it for the generic case of 'portrait-dialog text area is full (line_count/row_idx == 3), scroll the visible text up one logical line (19 px) to free the bottom line': caller 1 fd2_display_dialog_scene on LINE-ADVANCE(-2)/PAGE-BREAK(-3) opcodes while a portrait is active; caller 2 fd2_roll_stat_gain_and_show_message for routine level-up/promotion stat-gain messages (not cinematic, not a special scene). Proposed name keeps fd2_ prefix, names the domain (portrait dialog), the action (scroll text up), and the one-logical-line granularity. Convention-compliant, no address residue. NOTE: rename only recorded here, applied in Stage 2 (touches protos.h + 3 call sites).
purpose: When a portrait is on screen and the dialog text area is full, scroll the visible text upward by one logical line (19 px) so a new line can flow in at the bottom.
logic_summary: Gate: returns immediately unless data_fd2_dialog_active_portrait_blit_offset is 0x728 (left portrait) or 0x9017 (right portrait). Picks framebuffer text-area base fb_offset = 0xA0B4F (left, mode 0x728) else 0xA951F (right). Then 5 outer passes: each pass memmove's 0x48 (72) rows of 0xD0 bytes, src 3 rows below dst at row stride 0x140, then memset the bottom 0xD0-byte row at fb_offset+0x5A00 to text-bg pixel 0x4A. A final pass shifts up by 4 rows (same 0x48 rows, 0xD0 bytes) and clears the bottom row again. Net scroll = 5*3 + 4 = 19 px rows upward. The fb_offset-1 in memmove addresses the low byte; memset uses fb_offset (no -1).

returns.semantics: No return value; effect is in-place modification of the dialog text framebuffer region.

reads_globals: data_fd2_dialog_active_portrait_blit_offset (0x53C67) -- selects left/right text area and gates whether any scroll happens
notes: void(void), so params=[]. Writes only raw framebuffer addresses via memmove/memset (not named globals), so writes_globals=[]. Source comment block (dialog.c lines 717-730) is accurate, precise, ASCII-clean, and matches the decompilation exactly (portrait gate, left/right fb_offset, 5x shift-3 + final shift-4 passes, 0x4A fill) -> comment_verdict=keep.
